question: Should `isReplySessionInitConflictError` become a supported third-party Plugin SDK contract with exact-message semantics?
rationale: The export permanently expands the public SDK and standardizes behavior used by five message-delivery paths, so implementation correctness alone cannot choose the long-term contract.

options.title: Approve the narrow predicate
options.body: Keep the predicate-only export, document and test its exact semantics, restore the unrelated shim, and require real-runtime proof before merge.

options.title: Keep classification internal
options.body: Remove the public SDK export and use an approved internal runtime seam or retain local classifiers until a stable external error contract is designed.

options.title: Pause the refactor
options.body: Close or defer this PR if no owner wants to support this classifier as public API, leaving the existing channel behavior intact.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow predicate
recommendation.body: Keep the predicate-only export, document and test its exact semantics, restore the unrelated shim, and require real-runtime proof before merge.
